format: JavaScript (Node.js script with ES Modules syntax)
description: This script generates Swift code reflecting security policies based on a JSON configuration. It reads a JSON file defining policy rules, then outputs a Swift file that defines these policies as constants within an enum. It also supports check-and-write modes to verify or update the generated file.

methods.name: renderSwiftStringArray
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into a Swift array initializer syntax with proper indentation, used for generating code.
